examples.explanation: Powers of 3 are positive, so -1 is impossible.

hints: Any power of 3 is positive, so non-positive inputs are immediately false.
The largest power of 3 fitting in 32 bits is 3^19 = 1162261467, and every smaller power divides it.
Alternatively divide out factors of 3 in a loop until the value is no longer divisible.
title: 413. Power of Three
